DeviceOn for Edge AI also provides real-time monitoring and management from edge AI devices to cloud-based AI. Combined with server-class AI performance, an industrial-grade design, and edge management, the AIR-030 series is the ideal solution for AGV, AMR, robotics, and video analytics applications. This edge AI system is equipped with comprehensive I/O options, including CANBus for motion and direction control, LAN, USB and optional PoE for camera input, and DI/O for sensor control.
